relevance_note: HA20 cohort study: "A cohort of twelve patients with HA20 is followed at the NIH Clinical Center."; five of them are described individually with their variants, e.g. "P1 was a 15-year-old female with p.T604Rfs*93".
method_note: Hand-extracted from the Markdown full text; no table was transcribed by a script, and every span was checked to occur verbatim in the paper. Scope: "A cohort of twelve patients with HA20 is followed at the NIH Clinical Center." Individual-level facts are printed only for P1-P5 (active disease) and P6-P8 (quiescent; they are labelled only in the Fig 1C legend, so that legend supplies their label span). P9-P12 are never mentioned and get no rows; they are counted in cohort_size_as_stated = 12. HC1-HC4 (healthy volunteers) and "patients with primary interferonopathies" are out of scope. n_patients_reported = 8: the eight patients this paper names as HA20 patients (P1-P8); variants are printed for five (P1-P5) and the authors state twelve patients are followed. Uncertainties and decisions: (1) "aged 28, 32, and 61" for P2-P4 is not assigned to individuals by position, so their ages are not reported. (2) Zygosity and variant type are not reported for anyone: the only such statement is the general disease sentence "Patients with heterozygous loss-of-function TNFAIP3 mutations develop haploinsufficiency of A20 (HA20)", which is not about a named group of these patients. (3) The statement "All patients were diagnosed by Sanger sequencing, and increased NF-kB activity was confirmed with luciferase assay" is used as clinical_diagnosis_basis for P1-P8 and its luciferase-assay part as functional_evidence_statement. (4) P6-P8 have no printed variant, so their variant row keeps variant_original_string = 'not reported'. (5) 'P5 was asymptomatic' names no specific feature, so it produced no phenotypic_features row; 'No opportunistic or severe infections were reported during treatment' names a narrower category than the checklist item 'recurrent infections', so that item stays 'not reported' for everyone. No feature was recorded as 'excluded' anywhere. (6) 'retinal vasculopathy' (P2) is recorded as the feature as stated and mapped to the checklist item 'uveitis or other ocular inflammation'; the checklist item 'vasculitis' was left 'not reported' because the paper writes 'vasculopathy'. (7) P5's 'autoinflammatory liver disease' / 'autoinflammatory hepatitis with fibrosis' was not equated with the checklist item 'autoimmune hepatitis', which stays 'not reported' for P5. (8) is_proband = false and cites_prior_report_of_same_patients = false have no span; the paper contains no supporting sentence (spans are optional for these). No contradictions were found inside the paper.
